title: ELEMENTS OF DISCRETE MATHEMATICS
description: Elementary logic and set theory, functions, direct proof techniques, contradiction and contraposition, mathematical induction and recursion, elementary combinatorics, basic graph theory, minimal spanning trees.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: MTH 111Z, 111, 112Z*, 112*, 227*, 241*, 245*, 251Z*, 251HZ*, 251*, 251H* or minimum score of 060 in 'Math Placement - ALEKS'.
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of C- is required in MTH 111Z, MTH 111, MTH 112Z, MTH 112, MTH 227, MTH 241, MTH 245, MTH 251Z, MTH 251HZ, MTH 251 and MTH 251H.
